summary.headline: No semantic advantage beyond diff structure was established: a semantics-free character-level diff control matches the detector under the pair constraint (0.8588 vs 0.8596). The contribution is the measurement of shortcut-driven performance.

primary_result.question: Does enforcing paired consistency improve decisions?
primary_result.interpretation: Pair-coupled decoding gives stable row-level and group-level gains.

summary.main_limitation: Evidence localization and safe flip gates remain pseudo-label/small-queue diagnostics.

rows.question: Can a standard split look solved?
rows.interpretation: High score, but treated as artifact-sensitive rather than robust evidence.

rows.question: Does the same model survive vulnerable/fixed pairing?
rows.interpretation: Near-chance paired behavior invalidates the easy same-source headline.

rows.question: Can metadata/candidate/counterpart controls explain the result?
rows.interpretation: These three controls remove the diff, so they bound metadata and single-side context only. They do NOT protect the paired-diff formulation: a semantics-free character-level diff control reaches 0.8588 under the pair constraint.

rows.question: Does diff-only reasoning form a stable harder-split signal?
rows.interpretation: WITHDRAWN as a semantic result. Matched by a semantics-free character-level diff control; no advantage beyond diff structure established.

rows.question: Does the paired diff signal depend on Project/CVE/CWE prompt metadata?
Does enforcing paired consistency improve decisions?
rows.interpretation: Pair-coupled decoding gives stable row-level and group-level gains.

rows.question: Is evidence localization independent of side decisions?
rows.interpretation: WITHDRAWN. The target is antisymmetric in the predicted side, so this contrast is an identity of the labelling function, not a measurement.

rows.question: Can high-confidence side inversions be repaired safely?
rows.interpretation: WITHDRAWN as a validated claim. Precision 1.0 rests on 4 accepted pairs (exact 95% CI [0.3976, 1.0]) and the gate was selected on the pool it is reported on.
